```{css echo=FALSE}
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cal+Sans&family=Micro+5&display=swap');

.author, .title, .subtitle, h2 {
    margin: 0px 0px 10px 0px;
}

.author {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg,#ED7B84 0%, #6290C8 50%, #49306B 100%);
    background-clip: text;
    color: rgba(0,0,0,0);
    background-size: 100% 100%;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    display: block;
    width: max-content;
    margin: 0px 0px 10px 0px;
    font-family: "Micro 5", sans-serif;display: block;
    font-size: 30px;
}

body {background: #ECEBE4;} 

h1, h2, h3 {font-family: "Cal Sans", sans-serif;display: block; color: #49306B;}

div.section, div#header {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  border-radius: 10px; 
  padding: 20px;
  margin: 20px;
  
  animation: slideIn ease-in-out both;
  animation-timeline: view();
  animation-range: entry 5% entry 20%
  
}

html {
overflow-x: hidden;
}

.figcaption {
  color: #777;
}

@keyframes slideIn {
from {transform: translateX(50vw); background: rgba(98, 144, 200, 0.5)}
to {transform: translateX(0px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {div.section, div#header {animation: none !important;}}
/* I hope the animation isn't too obnoxious for everyone else... */
```
